evidence.source: research/compass/registry.jsonl (S01, S04, S06-S10, S12-S16a; S02, S03, S06-Tier A, S11, S12b pending at this version)

exits.invalidation: 5-minute close through the signal's swing level

quick_scalps.symbols_rule: index products only (SPY, QQQ, IWM, SPXW, RUTW)
quick_scalps.note: rejected on SPY/QQQ/IWM 0DTE (S01: -$4.19/contract [-5.68, -2.81], -$2.03 vs matched random) and on SPXW 0DTE (S09: -$46.18 [-63.19, -30.02], -$24.09 vs random); the entry rule has no forward information on the underlying (S04, S06)

trend_plays.note: no forward move after the trigger on index ETFs intraday (S06); at daily resolution single-name trend pullbacks underperform the universe for 1-4 weeks (S07: -97 bp adjusted at 21 sessions [-141, -55])

breakouts.note: no forward move after 5-minute breakouts/retests on index ETFs (S06, -8 to -12 bp vs random at 60 min); daily 20-day breakouts underperform (S07: -81 bp at 21 sessions [-133, -33])

bounces.note: absolute forward return zero on index ETFs (S06); the apparent advantage over matched random was a control artefact (amendment A1)

earnings_events.note: no post-earnings drift in the surprise direction on 10,439 reports 2024-2026; beats underperform the universe after the gap (S08)

cheap_options.note: not run as an option test: every entry trigger available to it has zero or negative underlying expectation, and a cheap long option on such an entry loses its full cost (protocol §13)

expiration_categories.note: last trading day is the decision date; AM-settled SPX monthlies stop trading the session before

ranking.definition: mean net P&L per contract of the family's training trades in the same (expiration category, delta band, liquidity class, regime) cell, divided by the mean maximum adverse excursion (entry ask − lowest bid before exit) of those trades; dollars per contract over the hold; cells with fewer than 100 trades show 'unavailable'
ranking.unavailable_label: no validated configuration: ranking has no inputs

rejected.result: 2,886 fills; -$4.19/contract [-5.68, -2.81]; win 34.3 %; PF 0.73; strategy minus matched random -$2.03 [-3.18, -0.90]; negative every year
forward 30-min signed return -0.7 to -1.6 bp vs +4.6 to +7.7 bp for random minutes on the same days; RSI cross alone 0.0 bp; no ablation positive
rejected.verdict: no forward information; fires after the move

rejected.result: 84 cells; every raw trigger within +/-1 bp of zero at 30/60 min; the baseline filter stack lowers every trigger vs random; nothing promoted under the two-part rule

rejected.result: nothing promoted; breakout20 -81 bp at 21 sessions [-133, -33], trend_pullback -97 bp adjusted [-141, -55]; others straddle zero
rejected.verdict: nothing promoted; the two frequent continuation triggers predict the opposite sign

rejected.family: earnings_events (surprise sign / event-day move, gap and drift entries)
rejected.result: nothing promoted; surprise direction underperforms the universe after the gap (-25 bp adjusted at 10 sessions [-39, -9]); event-day move predicts nothing

rejected.result: best cell +$0.52/contract [-6.11, +7.47] (breakeven; -$1.34 with one adverse tick); verticals and 60-min holds negative

rejected.family: intraday momentum (first half hour -> rest of day / last hour); 15:00 0DTE long expression
rejected.result: last-half-hour momentum absent; QQQ-only rest-of-day +9.0 bp [+2.8, +15.3] on large-move days (10/10 years positive) but Bonferroni lower bound -2.5 across the A5 batch; option cell -$4.36 [-8.48, +0.21]

rejected.family: cross-sectional momentum / reversal long legs, month-end deciles
rejected.result: 20-34 rebalance dates; intervals hundreds of bp wide; reversal +247 bp adjusted [-38, +598] with flipping year signs

no variant with a positive lower bound or beating random; walk-forward OOS -3.81 [-5.23, -2.35] (lower bound), -2.49 [-7.32, +2.46] (EP/EWD)
